questions.answer: It was very easy to find something that met my needs through Airbnb

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer:
In terms of living off campus, I definitly missed out on social parts of being an exchange students.
At the same time, living off campus allowed me to have my own place, not having to be around someone else 24/7 - so to live on/off campus really depends on your preferences!

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer:
The system for registering for classes is very different from home - first come, first serve.
I was on a plane when the portal opened for applications, so I had to wait for the second round where I had to mail the professors directly. While it was stressfull, it worked out just fine.
